info.name: AngleApp
info.description:
Full API surface for angle-app — analysis, instruments, paper trading (replay + live NSE + live MCX), and auth.

Usage: import both this collection AND the AngleApp Local environment; then top-right dropdown → select the environment.

Auth: collection root uses HTTP Basic (alex/demo123). Auth/Home/Dashboard folders override to no-auth. Admin folder uses admin credentials. If you run with spring.profiles.active=nosec, set collection Auth to No Auth.

item.name: Bias Dashboard
item.description:
Live daily-bias sheet — one URL per instrument.

HTML page: /bias or /bias/{token}
JSON API: /api/bias/sheet, /api/bias/sheet/{token}, /api/bias/all

Default instrument comes from bias.instruments[0] in properties. Ad-hoc tokens (not in config) work via /bias/{token} and pick up correct exchange from scrip master.

Requires {{crudeToken}} to be populated. Look up front-month via /api/instruments/futures?underlying=CRUDEOIL
Returns bias sheet for every configured instrument in one call.

item.name: Bias Dashboard — Section Extracts
item.description:
Same as the JSON sheet, but pre-tested against a specific section for quick review.

All requests use jq-style paths — Postman doesn't apply them automatically, but the URL returns the full sheet and Postman's response filter (top-right of the response body panel) lets you drill into $.marketContext, $.vix, etc.

Key fields:
- recommendation: LONG-ONLY / SHORT-ONLY / NO-TRADE
- totalScore: sum across all dimensions
- strength: STRONG / MODERATE / WEAK / NONE

item.name: Stock Quote (live price + indicators)
item.description:
Combined endpoint: live price + grouped technical indicators (momentum / trend / movingAverages / volatility) + signal labels + crossover flags.

Response groups:
  candle      — OHLCV for that bar (day-breakdown only)
  momentum    — RSI(14), MACD(12,26,9)
  trend       — ADX(14), SuperTrend(10,3)
  movingAverages — EMA9/20/50/200, SMA20, VWAP
  volatility  — ATR(14), Bollinger Bands(20,2)
  signals     — OVERSOLD/NEUTRAL/OVERBOUGHT, TRENDING/RANGING, BULLISH/BEARISH…
  crossovers  — ema9AboveEma20, ema20AboveEma50, priceAboveEma200, priceAboveVwap

Interval options: ONE_MINUTE, FIVE_MINUTE, FIFTEEN_MINUTE, THIRTY_MINUTE, ONE_HOUR, ONE_DAY

item.name: Regime Detector (signal gates)
item.description: Config-toggleable market-condition gates that filter signals BEFORE they save. Three independent gates: ADX regime (trend/range/mixed), India VIX ceiling, time-of-day windows. Any disabled gate always passes. Master switch: regime.enabled=false bypasses everything.

request.description: Returns current state: which gates are on, ADX allowed regimes, current India VIX vs ceiling, current IST time vs allowed windows.
Dry-run: tells you whether a Nifty signal RIGHT NOW would be allowed to fire. No signal is saved; safe to poll.
Re-parses allowed-regimes and allowed-windows CSVs. Also flushes the regime cache. Use this after editing application.properties and hot-reloading them (or use /admin/config-reload).

item.name: Flip master switch OFF (bypass all gates)

request.description: Runtime toggle. Once off, EVERY signal fires (as before regime was added). Useful to sanity-check that regime is what's filtering signals.
Disable just the ADX regime gate while keeping VIX + time filters active.
Disable the time filter to allow signals at ANY hour (useful for testing outside market hours).

item.name: Trailing Stops (ratchet)
item.description: Config-toggleable trailing-stop engine. Runs on every tick; tightens each OPEN signal's stop when price moves favorably. Never loosens. Modes: NONE / FIXED / PERCENT / MILESTONE / ATR.

request.description: Reverts to classic fixed-stop behavior. All OPEN signals keep their current stop (last-known trailed value stays).
Discrete profit-locking. Default ladder locks breakeven at 50%, 33% at 75%, 66% at 90% of the move.
Best for gappy or high-vol instruments. Trail = K × ATR14 behind peak.

item.name: Tune — tighter PERCENT (0.25% trail, activate at 20%)

request.description: Aggressive: engages sooner (20% into move) and trails closer (0.25%). More trades stopped early, but locks in profit faster.

item.name: Tune — looser PERCENT (0.6% trail, activate at 50%)

request.description: Conservative: waits until halfway, gives price more room. Fewer stop-outs, less profit locked.
Set your own ladder. Format: CSV of 'moveAt%:stopAt%'. Example below: at 40%→BE, at 70%→50% locked, at 90%→80% locked.

item.name: Multi-Timeframe Confirmation
item.description: After consensus + dedupe fire but BEFORE save: verify higher timeframes agree in direction. Signal on 5M BUY only saves if 15M + 1H both agree UP. Modes ALL/MAJORITY/ANY. Methods EMA_STACK / PRICE_VS_EMA / SUPERTREND. Master switch: mtf.enabled=false bypasses.

item.name: Dry-run — would Nifty 5m BUY be confirmed?

request.description: Reports whether a hypothetical BUY signal on Nifty 5m would pass MTF right now. Shows each higher-TF direction so you can see why.

item.name: Dry-run — would Nifty 5m SELL be confirmed?

request.description: Widen to 3 higher timeframes. With mode=ALL this becomes strictest — 3-of-3 must agree.
